about: Phase 8 head-to-head: 30 tasks over the demo closet (data/demo_closet/, items numbered by file prefix 1-27). Fixed before any run; evaluation/head_to_head.py checks this file's SHA-256. 'question' is sent word for word to every arm. The other fields are the scoring truth, written by hand: 'occasion' and 'weather' are what the rules check an outfit against; 'exclude' lists item numbers the answer must not use; 'missing' is a regex for the thing the closet does not have (the answer must say so); 'budget' is in rupees; 'want' is the product asked for; 'manual' marks the 10 tasks for arm 3.
